components.name: Default Button
components.description: White square button with a 2px ink border and tall-caps label.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: #0a0a0a; font: 800 18px 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f2f2f2; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black plate button for the one main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; background: #0a0a0a; color: #fff; font: 800 18px 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White square field with 2px ink border and a tall-caps label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font: 800 17px 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: #0a0a0a; font: 400 15px Roboto, sans-serif; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: White record sheet on a turned black under-sheet.
components.html:
Orders
Twelve rows of figures.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; isolation: isolate; margin: 8px 10px 14px 0; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; color: #0a0a0a; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 18px 30px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); font: 400 15px/1.5 Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px -7px -8px 7px; z-index: -1; background: #0a0a0a; transform: rotate(0.35deg); transform-origin: 0 100%; } .ds-panel-head { padding: 10px 14px 8px; border-bottom: 3px solid #0a0a0a; font: 800 22px 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 14px; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Square hatched mark plus caps label: active, watch, lapsed, new.
components.html: Active Watch Lapsed New
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-right: 14px; font: 800 17px 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2px solid currentColor; } .ds-chip.active::before { background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-chip.watch::before { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, currentColor 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); } .ds-chip.lapsed::before { border-color: #c8000f; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #c8000f 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #c8000f 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); }

components.name: Berth Strip
components.description: Twelve month cells: hatch density 1-4 for order load, red cross-hatch for quiet, dotted for before the client existed.
components.html: 1236
components.css: .ds-berth { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 44px); gap: 6px; padding: 14px; background: #fff; } .ds-cell { position: relative; height: 44px; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; display: grid; place-items: end start; font: 700 12px/1 'Roboto Mono', monospace; overflow: hidden; } .ds-cell b { margin: 2px; padding: 1px 4px; background: #fff; color: #0a0a0a; font-size: 12px; } .ds-cell.pre { border-style: dotted; border-color: rgba(10,10,10,0.55); } .ds-cell.l1 { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a0a 0 2px, transparent 2px 9px); } .ds-cell.l2 { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a0a 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px); } .ds-cell.l3 { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a0a 0 3px, transparent 3px 5px); } .ds-cell.l4 { background: #0a0a0a; } .ds-cell.struck { border-color: #c8000f; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #c8000f 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #c8000f 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px); }

components.name: Nav Rail
components.description: Black nav sheet with caps items, inverted current page, white count badge and red extent bar.
components.html: OverviewClientsUnmatched4
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 244px; padding: 20px 0; background: #0a0a0a; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 18px 30px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); } .ds-rail a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 11px 18px 13px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font: 800 21px 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); } .ds-rail a[aria-current='page'] { background: #fff; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-extent { position: absolute; left: 18px; bottom: 5px; width: 90px; height: 3px; background: #c8000f; } .ds-badge { margin-left: auto; min-width: 24px; padding: 2px 8px; background: #fff; color: #c8000f; font-size: 17px; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview:
The CRM is a darkroom under a safelight. A red room fills the margins, the top bar and the sign-in; the work sits on white record sheets, each laid over a black under-sheet turned a fraction of a degree, like exposure sheets stacked on a bench. Heavy tall caps name things, Roboto carries prose, Roboto Mono carries figures, dates and codes. The look is dense, ruled and flat: black hairlines, dotted row dividers, zero radius.

State is never a new colour. How busy a month was is hatch density; a quiet or lapsed account is cross-hatched in red; a month before the client existed is dotted. Colour is red, black and white only, in all three themes (Safelight red room by default, White, Black); themes swap tokens and never change the grammar.
keyCharacteristics: Red room, white sheets, black under-sheets and black nav sheet.
Three type voices: tall caps for naming, Roboto for reading, mono for figures.
State as hatching in a fixed cell (solid, 1-4 hatch densities, red cross-hatch, dotted).
Zero radius everywhere; 2px control borders, 1px panel border, 3px and 6px structural rules.
Red, black, white only; no second accent.

rules.name: The Three Colours Rule
rules.body: Red, black and white only. A new state is a new hatch or a new mark, never a new hue.

rules.name: The Red Is State Rule
rules.body: Red marks the room, lapsed/quiet/error, and the single Add affordance on phones. It is never decorative on a sheet.

rules.name: The Token Swap Rule
rules.body: Components read --bed, --pane, --ink, --plate, --rail-bg, --bad, --ok, --badge; a theme changes tokens only.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Naming and labelling is tall caps; reading is Roboto; anything you could add up or look up is mono.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Prose Rule
rules.body: Where condensed caps host explanatory text (panel sub-lines, legend, page-head paragraph), reset to Roboto sentence case.

rules.name: The Under-Sheet Rule
rules.body: A raised surface is a white sheet over a turned black sheet, not a bare drop shadow. Hard offset shadows are not part of this system; the black sheet is a layer, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Settle Rule
rules.body: The only entrance motion is the head sheet settling (0.5s); fresh timeline rows fade 1.6s. Nothing shimmers; loading placeholders are plain blocks.

dos: Do put every raised surface on a white pane with the black under-sheet (turned 0.35 to 0.5deg) and the sheet shadow.
Do express new states as hatch patterns in the 18px mark or month cell, using ink or red only.
Do use Big Shoulders caps for names and labels, Roboto 15px for prose, Roboto Mono for figures.
Do keep radius at 0 and borders at 1px, 2px, 3px or 6px by role.
Do switch themes only by swapping tokens; check red-on-white uses --bad-ink.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent or any hue beyond red, black, white.
Don't use grey SaaS cards, rounded corners, hero metrics or gradients other than hatching.
Don't set prose in the condensed caps face; reset to Roboto sentence case.
Don't let red decorate; it means room, lapsed, error or Add.
